phrase: I want my dog to do a bullet time thingy when I throw him a bone, dramatically

spec.movement: locked: the camera does not move, the action comes to it
spec.placement: on the floor, 3 m away, the lens level and looking along the ground into the light
spec.lens_why: An ultra-wide lens on the floor makes the ground rush to the lens and gives a small jump real scale.
risks: Do not tilt the lens up at the face: it bends bodies and generators stretch them. Keep the lens level.
Slow motion plus a jump invites floating. Write a real height and real gravity.

one_line: A scruffy brown dog at the top of a jump, about to catch a thrown bone, seen from a locked camera on the floor with an ultra-wide lens, the lens level, looking along the ground into the light; 18 mm lens; low, hard late-afternoon sun from one side only; one side of the subject lit, the other side in real shadow; long hard-edged shadows across the ground; bleach-bypass look: high contrast, low saturation, silvery highlights, dense blacks, visible grain; slow motion for this one beat only; real gravity, weight and cloth move truthfully, nothing floats. Avoid: not a default eye-level medium shot; no soft even glow; one motivated light source with a real dark side; nobody looks into the lens; every eyeline goes to a target inside the scene; no slow floating camera drift; the camera is locked or makes one decisive move with a clear end; real gravity and real jump height, nobody floats; no bloom, no haze, no fog, no volumetric god rays.
prompt_block:
SHOT: Low-angle wide shot. 16:9 frame, 2 to 4 s.
SUBJECT AND ACTION: a scruffy brown dog at the top of a jump, about to catch a thrown bone, in a backyard lawn at sunset.
CAMERA MOVE: locked: the camera does not move, the action comes to it.
CAMERA PLACEMENT: on the floor, 3 m away, the lens level and looking along the ground into the light.
LENS: 18 mm.
LIGHT: low, hard late-afternoon sun from one side only; one side of the subject lit, the other side in real shadow; long hard-edged shadows across the ground.
COLOUR: bleach-bypass look: high contrast, low saturation, silvery highlights, dense blacks, visible grain.
SPEED: slow motion for this one beat only; real gravity, weight and cloth move truthfully, nothing floats.
RULES: State the exact number of people. Screen direction stays the same for the whole shot.
AVOID: not a default eye-level medium shot; no soft even glow; one motivated light source with a real dark side; nobody looks into the lens; every eyeline goes to a target inside the scene; no slow floating camera drift; the camera is locked or makes one decisive move with a clear end; real gravity and real jump height, nobody floats; no bloom, no haze, no fog, no volumetric god rays; worn real textures with dust, creases and small defects, nothing plastic or perfectly clean.
image_prompt:
A single still frame from a live-action film, 16:9 frame. A storyboard-grade production mock that shows framing, lens, light and colour.
SUBJECT: a scruffy brown dog at the top of a jump, about to catch a thrown bone, in a backyard lawn at sunset. Generic stand-in figures, not a likeness of any real person.
CAMERA: the camera is on the floor with the lens level: the ground stretches from the bottom edge of the frame to the subject, who is seen from the side against the light, with a lot of floor in the foreground. Camera placement: on the floor, 3 m away, the lens level and looking along the ground into the light.
LENS: 18 mm; ultra-wide lens look: deep perspective, a large foreground, a small far background, strong converging lines.
LIGHT: low, hard late-afternoon sun from one side only; one side of the subject lit, the other side in real shadow; long hard-edged shadows across the ground.
COLOUR: bleach-bypass look: high contrast, low saturation, silvery highlights, dense blacks, visible grain.
MOMENT: a crisp frame from slow motion: dust, cloth and hair caught sharp in mid-movement.
FACES: turned away from the lens, in profile, three-quarter or from behind.
AVOID: not a default eye-level medium shot; no soft even glow; one motivated light source with a real dark side; nobody looks into the lens; every eyeline goes to a target inside the scene; no bloom, no haze, no fog, no volumetric god rays; matte worn floor, no glossy or wet reflections; worn real textures with dust, creases and small defects, nothing plastic or perfectly clean; no over-saturated HDR look; restrained colour and true blacks; real gravity and real jump height, nobody floats; no lens flare unless the light source itself is in the frame.
One frame only: no collage, no split screen, no text, no captions, no logos, no watermark, no border.
